ModMetaData.name: Hardened Raids
ModMetaData.author: SHD2
ModMetaData.description:
Harder, more coherent raids for the late game.
Instead of throwing ever more naked raiders at you, raids first get better: healthier, more skilled, better armed and armored. Only then do they grow in numbers.
- No 10,000 points cap; wealth → points curves extended beyond 1M. - Equipment tiers (T1 to T6, N1 to N5 for tribals): health, skills, armor, weapons, implants. - Value-based pricing: a raider costs its body plus the market value of its gear. Quality by rank (soldier, NCO, officer); masterwork and legendary stay rare. - Uniform loadout per raid (same weapons, same ammo), taken from the faction's own item tables. - Strong armor and armored mechanoids are gated by raid points and by your colony's research. - Waves: up to 100 raiders per wave (industrial+), 300 (neolithic/medieval). - AI: smart, breach and sapper raids become more common at high tiers; veterans avoid turret fire; out-of-service turrets are ignored. - Reinforced sieges: modded artillery (Fortifications, VFE Security, CE Armory...), trenches, turrets; support teams during assaults. - Enemy vehicles (Vehicle Framework + Vanilla Vehicles Expanded, experimental): tanks, fire support, trucks and IFVs, with crews, ammo and fuel.
All optional mods are detected at runtime: Combat Extended, GiTS Cyberbrains, Simple Sidearms, Vehicle Framework / VVE, Fortifications, VFE Security.
Every feature can be tuned or disabled in the mod settings. Language option in mod settings (English by default, French available).
